calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-06-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Trish Abalos.
Petitioner: Shu Ping Yu, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Wennuo Yu and with Cantonese Interpreter: Jenny Yao.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner/Minor's Mother: Yan Jun Chen, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change of the minor.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Eddy Yu.
Decree signed in open court.
